verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it syncs with Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark and more, and offers webhooks for custom workflows. That directly names the three chat tools in the story, but the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documentation of which repository and pull request events trigger chat notifications, setup or configuration docs for each chat integration, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send repository and pull request notifications to chat tools like Slack, Discord, or Microsoft Teams

citations.quote: Sync seamlessly with tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark, and more.
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
